content: Item-agnostic precedents: DKP invented 1999 by Thott (Afterlife, EverQuest) when loot was unknown; Thottbot 2004 crowdsourced drop data via in-game plugin. EPGP GP slot multipliers (epgp.lua): head/chest/legs 1, shoulder/waist/feet/hands 0.75, neck/wrist/finger/cloak 0.5, trinket 0.75, one-hand/main-hand/shield/ranged 1.5, two-hand 2, offhand/holdable/thrown/relic 0.5. Wishlist response scales: Viserio BiS/Major/Sidegrade/Catalyst/Do not want; RCLC Need/Greed/Minor/Pass.
